description: A curated, expandable DAG of music genres for local-library discovery and genre-aware mixes. The first parent drives navigation; secondary parents represent crossovers, and related links represent editorial sonic proximity, not historical lineage.

rankingGuidance.parent: 0.48 broader subgenre / family (family root not sufficient on its own)
rankingGuidance.genre-is-not-mood: energy and mood come from audio analysis / explicit tags, not inferred solely from genre
rankingGuidance.library-only: recommend only songs present and playable in the user's own library; let missing source tags remain searchable
rankingGuidance.unknown: preserve unknown raw tags for search, never silently force them into Other
rankingGuidance.cold-start: if fewer than eight suitable tracks, show a filtered list rather than a misleading playlist
rankingGuidance.variety: diversify artists and albums; optionally order by existing flowOrder
